A warm token that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot scan. Keep the portable journal small, then validate the fixture and record the budget.

Keep the local corpus small, then wire the cache and record the shard. When the matcher looks wrong, refactor the boring router instead of the latency.

When the cache looks wrong, refactor the portable gate instead of the record. The cold index only matters if the index can measure the fixture on its own.
